releaseNotes: Apex GT3 Superbike Velocity Cockpit: 1) Monolithic 108sp central digital speed readout with pure white high-contrast daylight & night clarity. 2) Overhead calibrated GT3 tachometer ribbon (0-10,000+ RPM) with textured redline hatching. 3) Formula 1 / GT3 symmetrical sequential shift light array (10 micro-LED beacons). 4) CNC-machined integrated gear binnacle ([N] in racing green, [1-6] in electric cyan). 5) Precision telemetry wings for peak speed, trip distance, digital compass heading, and GPS satellite lock quality. 6) Strict sensor availability enforcement.
